scope: Original combat minimum reconstruction specification; static evidence, no runtime observation

evidence_types.recovered_control_flow: Decoded Kismet branch/call evidence, not observed gameplay
evidence_types.serialized_defaults: Cooked CDO/component/table values, may be overridden

facts.claim_zh: HeroAttackFunc设置Attacking(2)，按AttackIndex 0..3播放四段蒙太奇并循环；进入时清冲刺、寻找最近敌人、重置连招计数。
普通拳StopAttackMove通知先停止移动，再调用SpawnAttackCollisionEvent；该分支在AttackLocation生成BP_AttackCollirionNormal。不能因不存在同名spawn通知而漏掉命中。
补证确认普通近战主Sphere静态继承半径256，scale1；Sphere1/Box关闭碰撞。寿命0.1秒；RadialForce半径255/冲量400，非数值伤害。运行观察仍未执行。
AttackLocation模板相对偏移为(95,0,30)，实际世界坐标仍受组件父级/运行更新影响。
连招序号超时归零。默认1.5秒会被运行分支覆盖：空中远攻状态15/16为0.5秒，其他路径1秒；不能将默认1.5直接当攻击冷却。
FistCannon输入调用LongRangeAttack；状态与移动/飞行分支选择站立普通拳波、移动三连招、超级拳或空中远攻，GetIsHitReaction为原版阻断之一。
站立普通远攻R/L交替，播放速率是AttackAnimRate乘等级倍率；NormalLongAttack通知从AttackLocation世界变换生成拳波。
移动远攻索引0/1/2依次BackHandSlash、FlashKick、Smash；通知分别控制追敌、移动、spawn与可衔接状态。
移动远攻分支检查SuperPunchCounter>=1；HeroSuperLongAttackPunchFunc还检查IsDeathblowEnable，否则回落三连招。播放超级拳0.75倍并开启移动，通知生成BP_SuperPunch。
空中远攻通常R/L踢交替，采用普通远攻等级速率；Direction在[-20,20]且counter>=1且IsDeathblowEnable转AirSuperKick。
激活后从OpticRay actor位置做单条LineTraceSingle，通道值7、非complex、忽略自己/玩家；端点由摄像机forward*20000+位置，锁定Boss时改为Boss位置+up*60。双眼光束只是共享端点的视觉表现。
Pawn连续命中按HitCounter减delta，<=0时恢复HitInterval并派发弱ImpactForce；新目标/首次命中进入派发路径。非Pawn在另一分支直接ImpactForce，未经过此计数器；不能说所有物体统一10Hz。
Pawn处理链还尝试BPI_Citizen.SetCitizenState(4)，但市民模板忽略OpticRay碰撞；接口调用存在不等于原版一定能命中或杀死市民。
OpticRay对应特殊动作枚举2，表值cool=5、usable=600、loop=true；激光连续使用时ActionCoolTime累加到Max即停火/冷却，停用后以ActionCoolTimeMulti衰减；ActionUsableTime另按delta消耗。自由模式需绕过这些资源限制。
车辆ImpactForce仅IsStrong且未Destory?才设摧毁、爆炸、隐藏并AttackDestroy；弱命中只火花/音效。非敌方造成摧毁才SendHeroPoint(self,0,self)。
已解码BaseCitizen_CharaBP实现BPI_Citizen，未见PlayerImpact_BPI、数值HP或死亡流程；默认碰撞忽略Bullet/Hero/OpticRay，原逻辑主要走路、观察、逃跑。自由伤害需新接口/状态而非仅取消分数。
BaseEnemy把ImpactForce.IsStrong转给HitAttack.IsAirAttack，碰撞接口没有显式数值伤害参数；存在物理布娃娃与LaunchCharacter分支。该分支不能概括Boss数值血量。

timing_conversion.formula: sequence_time / (sequence RateScale * AnimSegment AnimPlayRate * PlayAnimMontage rate), plus any trigger offset; validate against animation playback
timing_conversion.normal_psa_warning: PSA nominal 1.6667 already reflects source 1.8333 / RateScale 1.1; when scheduling events against PSA-normalized time divide source notify time by1.1 once, do not speed clip by1.1 again

input.ascend: must remap original E; final key not chosen here

changes: Add explicit damage/knockback receivers to citizens and vehicles/props
Remove player damage, negative score, rank loss, involuntary control loss, ability resource limits and forced failure
Retain animation windup, hit timing and explicit combo gates as combat behavior, unless design deliberately revises them
approved_free_mode.suggested_heat_interval_policy: Use fixed0.1s ticks for all destructible receiver types as a deliberate new policy; original nonPawn branch is different

unknowns: Supplement recovers projectile speed/lifespan/flags and static inherited melee radius; native Normal/SuperPunch capsule dimensions and observed runtime behavior remain unconfirmed.
No invented generic HP/damage/DPS/cooldown values. Boss damage is outside this minimum spec.
Citizen State4 enum display name not decoded here; SetCitizenState4 is not proof of death.
Vehicle DT_HeroPoint row -2000 exists but SendHeroPoint helper mapping is not independently decoded here.
No original runtime observation: actual notify queue/frame timing, interruption/blend behavior and physics response require later comparison.
implementation_acceptance: Normal combo emits exactly one gameplay hit per selected notification execution and uses per-attack receiver deduplication.
Animation time scaling remains aligned to source events at multiple playback rates; PSA duration scaling is applied once.
Right mouse and added E heat vision coexist; releasing E stops beam and hit processing.
Heat ray stops at nearest blocking surface; visual beams follow two eye sockets but share gameplay hit.
Free mode allows intentional damage to citizens/vehicles/props without score loss or forced failure; mark this as new design.
Vehicle destruction triggers once and removes actor safely from city traffic/pool after its chosen effect lifetime.
